title: A Day in Anna's Town
text:
Anna lives in a small town. There is a big park near her house. She likes to walk in the park with her dog. There is also a library next to the park.

On Saturday, Anna goes to the market with her mother. The market is near the bank. They buy fruit and bread there. Then they eat lunch at a café.

questions.text: Where do Anna and her mother go on Saturday?
What kind of person is Anna probably?
Why do they probably eat lunch at the café?

vocabulary.definition: a public area with grass and trees
a place where people buy food and other goods
a place with many books to read or borrow
a place where people keep money and use financial services

paragraph_translations: Anna vive en un pueblo pequeño. Hay un parque grande cerca de su casa. Le gusta caminar en el parque con su perro. También hay una biblioteca al lado del parque.
El sábado, Anna va al mercado con su madre. El mercado está cerca del banco. Compran fruta y pan allí. Luego almuerzan en un café.
